messages:
Maya Patel: Hi team, stuck on Okta. Welcome email link goes to 'account mismatch' even though I'm using my company email. Chrome keeps picking my personal google account. Also 1Password shows no invite. Anyone know the fastest unblock?

Jordan (IT): Welcome Maya! Quick try: open the Okta link in an Incognito window or sign out of all Google accounts first. If that fails we can reissue the invite to a +alias so Google doesn't auto-select. Do you have a security key yet or just phone MFA?

Maya Patel: I only have phone MFA. Incognito didn't help, it still lands on mismatch. My work email is maya.patel@redwood.com, personal is maya.patel.dev@gmail.com.

Jordan (IT): OK will reprovision to maya.patel+rw@gmail.com and add a temporary Drive share so you can access onboarding docs immediately.

Onboarding Bot: Ticket #9012 created (IT:okta) -> assigned to Jordan. ETA ~2 hours.

Sam (People Ops): Maya, I approved a 1Password seat (ticket #9014). Jordan, can you ensure group membership so the seat syncs?

Noah (Manager): Approved from my side. Welcome Maya :tada: I asked Ops for view access to the team folder.

Jordan (IT): Done: reprovisioned invite to maya.patel+rw@gmail.com and added you to a provisional Drive folder (Viewer). 1Password invite should appear within ~10 mins. We'll mail a YubiKey; use phone MFA until it arrives. If you later want passkeys, see handbook > IT > SSO. Quick tip to force chooser:
```
- sign out of accounts.google.com
- open the Okta link in incognito
```

Maya Patel: I can access Drive and I got the 1Password email. Thanks everyone! I'll enroll phone MFA now and ping when the key arrives.

Jordan (IT): Great — ping if anything else.
